title: Traverse stage 2: Vivione -> Rif. Nani Tagliaferri -> Rif. Curo
terrain: ~23km, ~1600m D+ / ~1500m D-, pack; sustained descents after Tagliaferri

steps.target: Z1-Z2, run flats, hike all climbs

steps.note: long stop at Rif. Tagliaferri - full meal, refill

coachNotes: GO/NO-GO at wake-up: if morning HR is >55 or you feel any fever symptoms after the tent night, this becomes a hike-only day with the option to stop at Tagliaferri. ITB rules absolute on the Tagliaferri->Curo descents: poles, short stride, high cadence, walk anything technical. Lateral knee signal >2-3/10 = walk it in, no exceptions. Fuel 60-80g carbs/h from the start, don't ration.
